findings.highlight: carries a sharp chill
findings.evidenceJa: 頬を刺す冷気も一段と鋭い
findings.governingReading: the cold that stings his cheeks is sharper still
findings.explanation: The bodily point of contact and comparative intensification disappear.

findings.highlight: She comes closer and looks up at me
findings.evidenceJa: ずい、と身を乗り出して俺の顔を見つめるセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber abruptly leans forward and stares into his face
findings.explanation: Saber’s sudden, intent inspection becomes a generic approach and an unsupported upward gaze.

findings.highlight: Her fate is determined by my choice
findings.evidenceJa: 俺がどんな選択をしたかは、彼女にとって他人事じゃない
findings.governingReading: whatever choice he made was no matter concerning someone else for her
findings.explanation: Saber’s personal stake in Shirou’s decision is promoted into a claim that his choice determines her fate.

findings.highlight: I take a deep breath
findings.evidenceJa: 軽く深呼吸をして
findings.governingReading: takes a small, steadying breath
findings.explanation: The explicitly light breath is intensified.

findings.highlight: I don’t care what relationship a Master and his servant should have
findings.evidenceJa: マスターとサーヴァントの関係なんて知らない
findings.governingReading: he does not know what a Master–Servant relationship is
findings.explanation: Shirou’s ignorance is changed into indifference.

findings.highlight: I at least want our first greeting to be in style
findings.evidenceJa: 一番初めの挨拶ぐらいはキチンとしておきたかった
findings.governingReading: he at least wanted to make their very first greeting properly
findings.explanation: Earnest propriety becomes concern with style.

findings.highlight: Saber is really serious, so I nod
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが大真面目なものだから、こっちもつられて頷いてしまった
findings.governingReading: Saber is so utterly serious that Shirou finds himself drawn into nodding too
findings.explanation: The involuntary social pull of Saber’s seriousness is reduced to bare causation.

findings.highlight: I’m shaking hands
findings.evidenceJa: 冷えきった手で
findings.governingReading: with hands chilled through
findings.explanation: The cold physical intimacy of the handshake disappears.

findings.highlight: you trust Saber now?
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの事は完全に信頼したってワケ？
findings.governingReading: does that mean you trust Saber completely?
findings.explanation: Rin’s teasing question loses its decisive degree.

findings.highlight: I won’t go easy on you either
findings.evidenceJa: わたしたちも容赦しないから
findings.governingReading: we will not show you any mercy either
findings.explanation: Rin’s warning explicitly includes Archer; mirror moon assigns it to Rin alone.

findings.highlight: I can’t fight him fairly
findings.evidenceJa: 気持ちよく戦えないだけよ
findings.governingReading: she simply could not fight him with a clear, satisfied heart
findings.explanation: Rin’s personal need to settle her debt becomes a claim about procedural fairness.

findings.highlight: No matter what the reason may be
findings.evidenceJa: カタチはどうあれ
findings.governingReading: whatever form it took
findings.explanation: The manner or form of Shirou’s intervention is changed into its reason.

findings.highlight: She turns away
findings.evidenceJa: ふん、と鼻を鳴らしてそっぽを向く
findings.governingReading: she snorts and turns her face away
findings.explanation: Rin’s defensive, irritated delivery loses its audible gesture.

findings.highlight: I’ll at least go back to town with you
findings.evidenceJa: 町に戻るぐらいまでは面倒みてあげる
findings.governingReading: she will look after them at least until they get back to town
findings.explanation: Rin’s grudging promise to take care of them becomes neutral accompaniment.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka starts to walk without looking at us
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちと目を合わせないように遠坂は歩き出した
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka starts walking while deliberately avoiding their eyes
findings.explanation: The deliberate embarrassment encoded by avoiding eye contact is weakened.

findings.highlight: follow Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: ずんずんと歩いていく遠坂
findings.governingReading: follow Tohsaka as she strides forcefully ahead
findings.explanation: Rin’s emphatic retreating gait disappears.

findings.highlight: Miyama City
findings.evidenceJa: 深山町
findings.governingReading: Miyama Town
findings.explanation: The named municipality is given the wrong category.

findings.highlight: I’ve been concerned with you
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮くんにかまけてて
findings.governingReading: she was occupied with Emiya
findings.explanation: Rin’s admission that Emiya consumed her time is softened into emotional concern.

findings.highlight: the battles between seven Masters, the Holy Grail War
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争っていう殺し合い
findings.governingReading: the mutual killing called the Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: The lethal definition of the ritual is euphemized as battles.

findings.highlight: I need to take it out on some other Servant
findings.evidenceJa: 他のサーヴァントでも仕留めないと気が済まない
findings.governingReading: she will not be satisfied unless she finishes off some other Servant instead
findings.explanation: A concrete compensating kill becomes the idiom for venting frustration on a target.

findings.highlight: is a magus
findings.evidenceJa: 一人前の魔術師だ
findings.governingReading: is a full-fledged magus
findings.explanation: The judgment of Rin’s completed professional standing loses its defining qualification.

findings.highlight: supported me, understanding the situation I’m in
findings.evidenceJa: 何も知らない衛宮士郎の立場になって肩入れした
findings.governingReading: put herself in ignorant Emiya Shirou’s position and sided with him
findings.explanation: Rin’s active perspective-taking and partiality are generalized.

findings.highlight: helped me out
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎の手を取った
findings.governingReading: took Emiya Shirou’s hand
findings.explanation: The concrete and relational image of Rin taking his hand is flattened.

findings.highlight: she’s sour, cranky, unapproachable
findings.evidenceJa: 性格はきついし、ツンケンしていて近寄りがたい
findings.governingReading: her personality is severe and she is prickly and hard to approach
findings.explanation: Loose pejoratives distort the specific public/private personality contrast.

findings.highlight: it’ll be a bother if she feels empathy for me
findings.evidenceJa: 情が移ると面倒
findings.governingReading: it would be troublesome if she grew attached
findings.explanation: A developing emotional bond is reduced to empathy.

findings.highlight: The silent suburbs
findings.evidenceJa: 人気の絶えた郊外
findings.governingReading: the deserted outskirts
findings.explanation: Population absence and the marginal setting become generic quiet suburbia.

findings.highlight: if your Servant ever gets killed
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントがやられたら
findings.governingReading: if your Servant is defeated
findings.explanation: The loss condition is narrowed to death.

findings.highlight: After letting out a sigh
findings.evidenceJa: 呆れた風に溜息をこぼした
findings.governingReading: lets out an exasperated-seeming sigh
findings.explanation: Rin’s exasperated judgment disappears from her reaction.

findings.highlight: she glances at Saber
findings.evidenceJa: ちらり、とセイバーを流し見た
findings.governingReading: she flicks Saber a sidelong glance
findings.explanation: The furtive direction and manner of Rin’s look are weakened.

findings.highlight: that’d really be soft
findings.evidenceJa: 感情移入になっちゃう
findings.governingReading: she would truly become emotionally invested
findings.explanation: Rin’s fear of emotional involvement is recast as generic softness.

findings.highlight: She turns her back and starts walking
findings.evidenceJa: 新都に向けて歩き出す遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka turns and starts walking toward Shinto
findings.explanation: The direction of Rin’s departure disappears.

findings.highlight: this gloomy town of shadow-pictures
findings.evidenceJa: 仄暗く青ざめた影絵の町
findings.governingReading: the dim, blue-pale silhouette town
findings.explanation: The uncanny blue pallor of the setting disappears.

findings.highlight: stands a figure that should not be there
findings.evidenceJa: 酷く、あってはならぬモノがそこにいた
findings.governingReading: something terribly impossible—something that must not exist—stands there
findings.explanation: Existential horror is weakened into an ordinary figure being in the wrong location.

findings.highlight: I can feel the giant’s dreadfulness all too well
findings.evidenceJa: 異質さは嫌というほど感じ取れる
findings.governingReading: he can feel the giant’s alien otherness all too keenly
findings.explanation: The perception that Berserker is categorically other becomes generic fearfulness.

findings.highlight: it feels like I am dreaming
findings.evidenceJa: 悪い夢を見ているようだった
findings.governingReading: it felt as though he were having a bad dream
findings.explanation: The nightmare evaluation disappears.

findings.highlight: I’m not even staring at it
findings.evidenceJa: 視線さえ合っていないのに
findings.governingReading: even though their gazes have not so much as met
findings.explanation: A lack of mutual eye contact becomes Shirou’s deliberate failure to stare.

findings.highlight: He surpasses Saber in raw power
findings.evidenceJa: 単純な能力だけならセイバー以上
findings.governingReading: in simple abilities alone, it is above Saber
findings.explanation: Rin’s comparison of basic capabilities is narrowed to strength.

findings.highlight: the spirit to not lose to it
findings.evidenceJa: それに負けまいとする、確かな気迫
findings.governingReading: a palpable fighting spirit refusing to yield to that despair
findings.explanation: A defining contrast between despair and resistance is rendered in clumsy, vague English.

findings.highlight: It’s a bit windy now
findings.evidenceJa: 風が出ていた
findings.governingReading: the wind had come up
findings.explanation: A definite change in the wind becomes a mildly qualified weather observation.

findings.highlight: I learnt more than enough about the situation I’m in
findings.evidenceJa: 事情はイヤって言うほど思い知らされた
findings.governingReading: the circumstances had been driven home until he was sick of them
findings.explanation: Shirou’s aversive experience of having the facts impressed on him becomes neutral acquisition of sufficient information.

findings.highlight: I don’t know if I’m good enough for you
findings.evidenceJa: 俺に務まるかどうかは判らない
findings.governingReading: he does not know whether he can fulfill the role
findings.explanation: Fitness to discharge the Master’s role becomes personal adequacy for Saber.

findings.highlight: yes, please
findings.evidenceJa: 頼む
findings.governingReading: I’m counting on you
findings.explanation: Shirou’s direct entrusting of himself to Saber becomes an awkward assent.

findings.highlight: We do not need to find out if our enemy is ready or not
findings.evidenceJa: 相手の覚悟など確かめるまでもない
findings.governingReading: there is no need to test the opponent’s resolve
findings.explanation: Archer’s rejection of testing an enemy’s resolve is weakened into checking practical readiness.

findings.highlight: Servants are spirits
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントは霊体だ
findings.governingReading: Servants are spiritual bodies
findings.explanation: A technical statement about Servants’ incorporeal state is turned into a categorical claim that they are spirits.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka is a complete Master
findings.evidenceJa: 完全なマスターである遠坂
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka is a proper or fully realized Master
findings.explanation: The contrast with Shirou’s defective Master capabilities is rendered in unnatural language that suggests personal completeness.

findings.highlight: I’ll go look while I’m here
findings.evidenceJa: 捜し物の一つもして帰る
findings.governingReading: do at least some searching before going home
findings.explanation: Rin’s concrete intention to accomplish at least one search task is reduced to an incomplete-sounding “go look.”

findings.highlight: I can’t go home now
findings.evidenceJa: ここで大人しく帰るなんて選択肢はないでしょう
findings.governingReading: quietly going home cannot be an option here, can it?
findings.explanation: Rin’s rhetorical rejection of meek withdrawal becomes bare inability.

findings.highlight: this part of her that’s unlike a magus
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師とは正反対の余分を持っている
findings.governingReading: an excess quality diametrically opposed to being a magus
findings.explanation: The sharp structural opposition between Rin’s humanity and magus identity is softened to mere difference.

findings.highlight: I don’t like it, but still, I’ll take that advice
findings.evidenceJa: 気が引けるけど、一応聞いておく
findings.governingReading: he feels reluctant, but will keep the advice in mind
findings.explanation: Shirou’s social reluctance to rely on the sanctuary becomes dislike of the advice itself.

findings.highlight: Even though Saber is strong
findings.evidenceJa: いくらセイバーが優れているからって
findings.governingReading: however exceptional Saber may be
findings.explanation: Saber’s general superiority is narrowed to physical strength.

findings.highlight: My vision is drawn to the top of the hill
findings.evidenceJa: 視線が坂の上に引き寄せられる
findings.governingReading: his gaze is drawn to the top of the hill
findings.explanation: A directed act of looking becomes the broader faculty of sight.

findings.highlight: isn’t an enemy that can be beaten head on. You should fight it in your unique style
findings.evidenceJa: 力押しでなんとかなる相手じゃない。ここは貴方本来の戦い方に徹するべき
findings.governingReading: this is not an opponent brute force can handle; you should devote yourself to your proper way of fighting
findings.explanation: The tactical contrast between brute force and Archer’s native method is shifted into direction of attack and generic uniqueness.

findings.highlight: She curtsies
findings.evidenceJa: 行儀良く、この場に不釣り合いなお辞儀をした
findings.governingReading: she gives a decorous bow incongruous with the situation
findings.explanation: A general, pointedly well-mannered bow is changed into the gendered and culturally narrower action of a curtsy.

findings.highlight: You should figure it out if I make that Illyasviel von Einzbern
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルンって言えばわかるでしょ
findings.governingReading: you recognize the name if I say Illyasviel von Einzbern, don’t you?
findings.explanation: Illya’s confident prompt becomes malformed English whose “make that” construction obscures the role of her full name.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s body stiffens
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の体がかすかに揺れる
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka’s body sways faintly
findings.explanation: A slight involuntary sway is replaced by bodily stiffening, changing Rin’s visible reaction.

findings.highlight: the strange shape behind her
findings.evidenceJa: 背後の異形
findings.governingReading: the grotesque being behind her
findings.explanation: The threatening abnormality of Berserker’s form is weakened into neutral strangeness.
